title: Garding Polynomials: the symmetric reduction on the boundary of the Garding cone (Proposition 9.11)
author: Hao Fang and Biao Ma
difficulty_reason: Counted unit: the paper's symmetric reduction on the boundary of the Garding cone, printed as Proposition 8.11 at source0.tex lines 2663-2675 and delivered with the paper's own complete proof (lines 2677-2728). The statement says that for a multi-affine polynomial symmetric in all variables, every boundary point of the Garding cone of its zero-th partial derivative can be moved to a diagonal point that stays on the boundary, inside the interval spanned by the given coordinates, and does not decrease the value of the polynomial. The proof is a source-local argument assembled from the paper's own machinery: it parametrises the boundary point along the diagonal, uses the retained basic lemma and the perturbation lemma to keep the trajectory on the boundary, tracks the sign of the derivative along the path, and finishes with the intermediate value theorem and the retained two-variable case. This is research-level convex algebraic geometry about Garding (hyperbolic) polynomials rather than a qualifying-examination exercise, and its proof is the paper's own; the unit is H2.
